questions: Which two scenes make it hard to know where to wait?
What has made a hospital visit easier or harder for you or someone you know?
Should the first fix be shade outside or clearer registration? Why?
Why might one registration desk become a bottleneck?
If waiting moves outdoors, what new difficulty may appear?
You have 500,000 BDT and 30 days. What one queue-management change would your grant test?

grant.pilot_scope: Pilot queue guidance and shaded waiting in one hospital service area; do not affect clinical triage.
